top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. The breach directly affects Microsoft Entra, a core IAM platform, with attackers targeting identity infrastructure data including admin accounts and tenant configurations.

top_stories.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
top_stories.summary: Rackspace disclosed a breach of its Spot cloud platform in which attackers used compromised credentials to gain unauthorized access to customer Kubernetes clusters. The attackers were able to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets stored within those clusters.

top_stories.title: VMware vCenter zero-day exploited for months before patch (CVE-2026-123890)
top_stories.summary: A China-nexus espionage group exploited a VMware vCenter zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) for over two months before Broadcom released a patch. The flaw allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to obtain an administrator session on vCenter Server, directly compromising privileged access to virtualized infrastructure.

top_stories.title: AI agent API security hasn’t caught up with agents already running in production
top_stories.summary: A Postman survey of nearly 9,000 developers, architects, and executives found that 25% of organizations already have AI agents calling APIs in production. Approximately 40% of respondents have not resolved how credentials and identity management will work for these agents, indicating a significant gap in machine identity and authorization practices.

top_stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
top_stories.summary: A China-linked threat group known as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability in VMware vCenter Server (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) in early September 2026. The flaw is an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service that allowed attackers to gain unauthorized admin access and steal data.

news.title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
news.summary: NordPass published content advocating for centralized password management over spreadsheet-based credential tracking for IT administrators. The piece focuses on improving credential visibility and reducing risks from weak, reused, or compromised passwords shared outside approved systems.

news.title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
news.summary: Microsoft released the KB5132057 preview update for Windows 11, containing 28 changes and fixes. The update includes improvements to Windows Hello, alongside other changes to Windows Search and the Run dialog.

news.title: Scope down permissions of existing sessions using AWS STS GetScopedCredentials
news.summary: AWS has launched a new Security Token Service API called GetScopedCredentials that allows developers to scope down permissions of existing sessions to only what specific tasks require. The API is designed for AI agent workflows where sub-agents should operate with least-privilege access rather than inheriting full parent session permissions.

news.title: Stock Looks Fully Valued On New Onboarding Security Tie Up
news.summary: SailPoint is highlighted in a financial analysis examining whether its 25.2% return over the past year is supported by its cash flows. The article focuses on stock valuation in the context of a new onboarding security partnership and upcoming investor events.

news.title: jumpserver v5.2.0
news.summary: JumpServer has released version 5.2.0 of its open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The platform provides DevOps and IT teams with secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.

news.title: Windows 11 passkey bug cries failure after successful sign-in
news.summary: Microsoft released an optional update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2 to fix a passkey authentication bug that displayed a misleading failure error after a successful Android sign-in. The bug caused the sign-in process to show an error message despite the passkey authentication completing successfully.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.6
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.6 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: Anzeige: Microsoft Entra ID: Identitäten und Zugriffe sicher verwalten
news.summary: Microsoft Entra ID is being promoted through a workshop focused on identity management and access protection configuration. The workshop covers hybrid environment setup and security strategies for Entra ID deployments.

news.title: Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day Flaw Lets Network Attackers Bypass Authentication
news.summary: Broadcom disclosed a critical zero-day vulnerability in VMware vCenter that allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized system access. Fixed versions have been released for all supported branches, with no available workaround provided.

news.title: Your AWS Security, Identity, and Governance guide to re:Invent 2026
news.summary: AWS is promoting its Security, Identity, and Governance track at re:Invent 2026, scheduled for November 30 to December 4 in Las Vegas. The event will cover identity management topics including AI agent identity, with sessions directed at security and IAM professionals.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports aliases to simplify workload configuration
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has added support for aliases, allowing administrators to assign human-readable names to trust anchors, profiles, and certificate revocation lists (CRLs). Workloads can now request temporary credentials using these alias names instead of ARNs, simplifying configuration and management.

news.title: Amazon Cognito now supports AWS Secrets Manager for app client secrets
news.summary: Amazon Cognito has added integration with AWS Secrets Manager, enabling user pool app client secrets to be stored and managed through Secrets Manager. This update affects how developers handle authentication secrets for applications using Cognito's sign-in and access control capabilities.

news.title: Identity context is essential for exposure management: Tenable One adds ways to bring in identity security data
news.summary: Tenable One has expanded its exposure management platform to ingest identity findings from third-party sources. The update enables security teams to assess and prioritize exposures related to stale and overprivileged accounts alongside vulnerability and misconfiguration data.

news.title: Major Brazilian Signature Apps Enable RCE & Fraud
news.summary: Brazilian government-sanctioned authentication middleware applications used for legally binding document signing contain remote code execution vulnerabilities. The flaws affect signature apps that serve as authentication mechanisms for high-value legal documents, exposing users to both RCE attacks and potential fraud.

news.title: NIST Finalizes Post-Quantum Cryptography Guidance, GAO Offers a Reality Check
news.summary: NIST has finalized its post-quantum cryptography guidance, establishing standards to protect sensitive data against quantum computing threats. A GAO report reveals that federal agencies are lagging in implementing these defenses, which directly impacts IAM systems relying on current encryption and authentication protocols.

news.title: Extortion Group Luna Moth Flits Into Law Firms a Second Time
news.summary: The Luna Moth extortion group is targeting law firms using social engineering tactics designed to steal Microsoft access tokens. The campaign specifically revisits law firms that previously refused to pay ransoms, focusing on credential and token theft as the primary attack vector.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update fixing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities across Windows and supported software, including 63 critical flaws. Among the patches is a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside updates from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.
